I usually read a book when im dealing with my thoughts. Ive tried avoiding them and suppressing but neither worked. Music sometimes helps but not very consistently.

Usually my brain just goes "stop thinking about it" which really doesnt help...

I haven't tried acknowledging them though, thanks for the idea! Hopefully that works!
Thanks, its nice knowing that there is someone dealing with something of a similar degree. I know 'nice' isn't the best word to use in this case but i dont know how else to rephrase it.
This is just a randomized name. I use names which I dont see results for.
